subject.title: fix(tui): preserve balanced parentheses in markdown link URL extraction (#100661)

question: Which open candidate PR should be the canonical fix for the TUI markdown URL-parentheses bug?
rationale: This branch appears correct, but two other open PRs target the same helper and issue; automation should not choose between viable contributor branches without maintainer intent.

options.title: Prefer this branch
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix if CI remains green because it covers markdown extraction, visible wrapping, and bare trailing-parenthesis punctuation with copied live output.

options.title: Use the smaller sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100680 instead if maintainers prefer the smaller equivalent implementation and its proof is accepted on re-review.

options.title: Pause duplicate candidates
options.body: Hold all candidate PRs until a maintainer explicitly selects one and closes or supersedes the others after merge.

recommendation.title: Prefer this branch
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix if CI remains green because it covers markdown extraction, visible wrapping, and bare trailing-parenthesis punctuation with copied live output.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the original OSC8 hyperlink helper through co-authorship and is a strong routing candidate for choosing the canonical TUI fix path.
